en.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash Video Editing
en.description: Edit a video with a prompt and use optional image references for characters, scenes, or style.

prompt.help: Describe what to add, remove, or replace. <IMAGE_REF_0> refers to the first reference image. Use up to 20,000 characters.

video.help: Upload an MP4 of up to 10 seconds or enter a public URL under Advanced.

reference_image_1.help: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Additional sources can be entered under Advanced.

thinking_level.help: A higher level may improve the result for complex prompts and increase generation time.

seed.help: Enter an integer. Use -1 for a random seed.

reference_image_2.help: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 20 MB. Additional sources can be entered under Advanced.

reference_image_sources.help: Enter one public image URL or Base64 data URL per line. These follow uploads, with a total limit of ten images.

video_source.help: Enter one public MP4 URL in place of an upload. The video can be up to 10 seconds long.
